description: This file defines the EntityOperations class which reacts to various entity lifecycle hooks in Drupal, such as preload, presave, insert, update, delete, revision delete, and form alter, specifically within the workspaces module. It manages entity support checks, workspace context, and hooks into entity operations to facilitate workspace-related behaviors.

classes.name: EntityOperations
classes.description: A class that reacts to entity lifecycle hooks in Drupal, managing workspace support and entity operations such as preload, save, delete, revision delete, and form alterations within the workspaces module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for entity type management, workspace management, tracking, info, and repository.

methods.name: entityPreload
methods.description: Handles the entity preload hook, loading entities within the active workspace context.

methods.name: entityPresave
methods.description: Handles entity presave hook, marking entities for workspace support and moderation.

methods.name: entityInsert
methods.description: Handles entity insert hook, processing new entities within supported workspaces.

methods.name: entityUpdate
methods.description: Handles entity update hook, managing updates within workspace context.

methods.name: entityTranslationInsert
methods.description: Handles insertion of entity translations, considering syncing status.

methods.name: entityPredelete
methods.description: Handles predelete hook, resetting cache for workspace entities and managing predelete logic.

methods.name: entityDelete
methods.description: Handles entity delete hook, tracking deletions and workspace cleanup.

methods.name: entityRevisionDelete
methods.description: Handles revision deletion, tracking and cleaning up revisions.

methods.name: entityQueryTagLatestTranslatedAffectedRevisionAlter
methods.description: Alters entity queries for latest translated affected revisions based on workspace tracking.

methods.name: entityFormAlter
methods.description: Alters entity forms to mark them as workspace safe and adds revision marking logic.

methods.name: entityFormEntityBuild
methods.description: Static method to mark entities as pending revisions and non-default revisions during form building.
